title: A Thousand Years of Waiting
content_zh:
A thousand years before the events of this story, a young scholar caught a white snake in the marketplace. He freed it into the wild, expecting nothing. What he did not know was that the snake was a spirit cultivator — and she remembered.
After a thousand years of cultivation, the white snake achieved human form. Beautiful beyond mortal measure, she took the name Bai Suzhen and descended West Lake in Hangzhou to find the scholar who had shown her kindness.
She found him, now reincarnated as Xu Xian, a humble apothecary's apprentice. On the Broken Bridge, under spring rain, their eyes met. She 'accidentally' dropped her umbrella. He offered to share his. It was love — or fate, or both.
But the monk Fahai could see through her human disguise. To him, a spirit and a mortal together was a contamination of the natural order. He warned Xu Xian, who dismissed the warnings as jealousy.
Fahai was not wrong about one thing: Bai Suzhen had not yet fully transcended her serpent nature. When she drank realgar wine on the Dragon Boat Festival, she collapsed and reverted to her true form — a massive white serpent. Xu Xian, seeing his wife transformed, died of shock on the spot.
Bai Suzhen journeyed to the heavens themselves and stole the Herb of Immortality to restore her husband to life. Her love would stop at nothing. Not even death. Not even the judgment of the gods.
